links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting with no examples; also Random Few-shot using shallow examples
links.outcome: Senior-clinician ratings of LLM-generated clinical Chains-of-Thought across human evaluation metrics
links.effect: Selective Few-shot significantly outperformed other strategies across all human evaluation metrics (p < .001); Random Few-shot offered no significant improvement over Zero-shot baseline
links.quote: The Selective Few-shot strategy significantly outperformed other strategies across all human evaluation metrics (p < .001).

links.comparator_used: Blinded review by senior ART clinicians
links.outcome: Ability to discern quality differences between prompting strategies for generated chains-of-thought
links.effect: GPT-4o evaluator failed to discern the performance differences that the clinician experts detected
links.tradeoff: AI evaluation missed differences between strategies, so it could not replace human expert evaluation for high-stakes clinical AI
links.quote: Notably, the AI evaluator failed to discern these critical performance differences.

design_hint: prompt curation with selective few-shot examples; expert clinician review of LLM outputs
